slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Toto fell asleep under the stars and woke on a half-flat air mattress. Familiar? ⛺

Thin mats and sagging blow-up beds let your hips sink and your back twist for hours, so a stiff morning is common. It usually settles once you start moving.

Camp-friendly tweaks: inflate firmly, lie on it for a minute, then let a little air out. Layer a towel or yoga mat under your hips. Pop a rolled jumper under your knees, or between them if you sleep on your side. Do 10 knee rocks and a slow lap of the campsite before lifting tents and eskies.

Pain spreading down a leg, pins and needles or weakness is worth getting assessed. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
